cues.text: A sunny school rooftop. The hero lies on a bench, his head in Aigis's lap. She wipes a tear away.
Wind turbines turn beyond the fence.
The hero gazes up at her, eyes half closed.
Cherry petals drift across a bright sky above the school.
The school's front entrance, framed by cherry trees in full bloom.
From behind, Aigis sits on the bench, the hero lying beside her. Solar panels beyond.
